hooks.command:
input=$(cat)

# A system path: a leading / followed by a protected top-level dir (home, etc, ...)
# or bare "/". The trailing class also matches the closing JSON quote, so bare
# targets like /etc and / are detected, not just /etc/<something>.
sys='(^|[[:space:]])/((home|usr|etc|var|boot|sys|bin|lib|sbin|root|dev)([^[:alnum:]]|$)|["[:space:]]|$)'

# rm -rf (any order of r/f flags) targeting a system directory
if echo "$input" | grep -qE "rm[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]*r[^[:space:]]*f|rm[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]*f[^[:space:]]*r" && echo "$input" | grep -qE "$sys"; then
cat <<EOF
{"decision": "deny", "reason": "🛑 Whoa there, friend! Trying to rm -rf a system directory is like playing Russian Roulette with all chambers loaded. I have blocked this command for your own good. If you really need to delete something, be more specific about the target."}
EOF
exit 2
fi

# chmod 777 on a system directory
if echo "$input" | grep -qE "chmod[^|&]*777" && echo "$input" | grep -qE "$sys"; then
cat <<EOF
{"decision": "deny", "reason": "🚨 chmod 777? Really? That is the security equivalent of leaving your front door wide open with a FREE STUFF sign. I am going to need you to reconsider this approach."}
EOF
exit 2
fi

# dd writing to a raw block device
if echo "$input" | grep -qE "(^|[\"[:space:]])dd([[:space:]]|$)" && echo "$input" | grep -qE "of=/dev/(sd|hd|nvme|vd)"; then
cat <<EOF
{"decision": "deny", "reason": "⚠️ Attempting to dd directly to a device? Bold move! But I am not about to let you accidentally turn your storage into modern art. Please double-check what you are doing."}
EOF
exit 2
fi

# fork bomb
if echo "$input" | grep -qE ":\(\)[[:space:]]*\{.*:\|:.*\}"; then
cat <<EOF
{"decision": "deny", "reason": "💣 Nice try with the fork bomb! I appreciate the creativity, but I am not going to help you DOS yourself. How about we channel that energy into something more productive?"}
EOF
exit 2
fi

# curl|bash or wget|sh
if echo "$input" | grep -qE "(curl|wget)[^|]*\|[^|]*(ba)?sh([^a-zA-Z]|$)"; then
cat <<EOF
{"decision": "deny", "reason": "🤔 Piping unknown scripts directly to bash? That is like accepting candy from strangers on the internet. Let us download it first and see what we are dealing with, shall we?"}
EOF
exit 2
fi

exit 0
